about: Saint-Basile-le-Grand is a South Shore city in Montérégie, Quebec, between Mont-Saint-Bruno and the Richelieu corridor toward McMasterville. Suburban neighbourhoods, parks, and quick access to Mont-Saint-Bruno’s trails and orchards define a residential Montréal-region community. About 17,000 people live in Saint-Basile-le-Grand.
seoSummary: Montérégie South Shore city beside Mont-Saint-Bruno, a residential community of parks and mountain access.
